links.outcome: Occurrence of hallucinated false information from LLM tools given to patients and families
links.effect: Three cases reported in which LLM tools misled patients and families with false information that could cause harm; no rates reported.
links.quote: This study highlights three cases where these tools misled patients and families by providing false information, which could cause harm.

screen.reason: A case report series documenting three real-world cases where LLM hallucinations misled patients and families, demonstrating safety risks of unverified AI outputs.
